### Required ground-support equipment (NOT flight mass)

- **`service_stand` is mandatory GSE, not an accessory** (r4 integration critic). Refill (directive 4) is 'take the whole dispenser off the aircraft', and B12 closes **only** with this part in the field kit: without it the dispenser stands on its own gearbox output flange. Print one per field kit; it is excluded from the flight ledger on purpose.
- `chute_plug` is ground-only storage kit (fitted between flights, removed before flight).

## Rolled up

- **SHIPPED HEADLINE BASIS (B11.2): slicer-realistic, 4 perimeters at 0.4 mm + 25 % infill, padded EDT -- LOADED @250 pellets = 1432.5 g against the 1500 g ceiling, margin +68 g.** This is what actually gets printed. (r9's BOM rolled up only the 100 %-infill number and the assembly critic correctly read it as 82.9 g over budget.)
- PESSIMISTIC BOUND, 100 % infill: empty (measured + estimates) 1164.5 g, +10% contingency -> 1281.0 g; loaded @250 pellets 1576.0 g (OVER the 1500 g ceiling by 76 g). Nothing is printed at 100 % infill; this is the bound, not the plan.
- loaded @421 (max fill rib), 100 % infill basis: 1777.8 g
- usable hopper volume 962 cm3 -> 421 pellets worst-case packing / 586 sphere basis
